articles.title: Percy Jackson Is Headed to Fortnite
articles.summary: Percy Jackson: Siege of Monsters will allow players to relive major moments from the novels and second season of the Disney+ series.
articles.body:
Percy Jackson is coming to Fortnite. The popular series, based on the novels by Rick Riordan and now streaming on Disney+, was just announced to be getting its very own Fortnite Island on December 9.

Revealed on stage at CCXP25 in Brazil, Percy Jackson: Siege of Monsters will allow players to “embark on an authentic Percy Jackson adventure across an island map inspired by Camp Half-Blood – the earthly sanctuary and training facility for the children of mortals and Greek gods. As newly arrived demigods, players must discover the identity of their godly parent, gain new divine powers, and ally with their fellow demigods for a climactic battle against Scylla and Charybdis on the Sea of Monsters.”

Players will be able to meet various characters from the popular stories, rendered in the likenesses of the actors from the streaming series, including Percy Jackson, Annabeth Chase, and Grover Underwood, and “complete multiple side quests” and other activities “inspired by the first two seasons of the show.”

I recently spoke with the stars and producers of the show about bringing some fan-favorite storylines to Fortnite. Walker Scobell, who plays Percy on the series, and co-star Aryan Simhadri (Grover) had been begging producers to get their characters into Fortnite “since day one.”

“I'm just excited to be the guy from Fortnite,” says Scobell. “That's what I want people to call me. If that's the only thing I'm ever remembered for, I'm fine with that. Percy Jackson? No, he's the guy from Fortnite.”

Series Executive Producer and Co-showrunner Dan Shotz, who presented a sneak peak of the Fortnite island at CCXP, says bringing Percy Jackson to the game involved a lot of moving pieces. “We have worked directly with Disney to build an entire world within Fortnite,” Shotz says. “You're going to get to see incredible monsters. You get to fight the Minotaur, you get to have a boss battle with Scylla and Charybdis, and you also just get to hang out with the gang from Percy Jackson. It's pretty epic.”

Dior Goodjohn, who plays Clarisse on the show, agrees: “It's really, really sick. You kind of know the magnitude of what you're doing when they put you in a video game or when you get a doll made of you. This is insane that this is real life for all of us right now. It's crazy.”

Percy Jackson Creator Rick Riordan says it was important to adapt his stories for a younger, modern audience. “I cannot tell you how many years the fans have been asking me, ‘When are we going to get a Percy Jackson immersive game?’” Riordan says. “I (played) my share of World of Warcraft when I was younger, (so) I get it. I totally get it.”

Leah Sava Jeffries, who portrays Annabeth, says she used to play Fortnite but intends to jump back in now that she and her co-stars are featured in the game. “This is making me want to go back and play it again,” Jeffries says. “I have been waiting for this for so long, and now I really feel like this is our moment.”

Season 2 of Percy Jackson and the Olympians hits Disney+ December 10.

Michael Peyton is the Senior Editorial Director of Events & Entertainment at IGN, leading entertainment content and coverage of tentpole events including IGN Live, San Diego Comic Con, gamescom, and IGN Fan Fest. He's spent 20 years working in the games and entertainment industry, and his adventures have taken him everywhere from the Oscars to Japan to Buenos Aires, Argentina. Follow him on Bluesky @MichaelPeyton

articles.title: Evacuation Procedures Walkthrough - Control Resonant Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Evacuation Procedures is the second Main Story mission of Control Resonant in the Contain the Crisis chapter. Now that you’ve been given the grand tour
articles.body:
Evacuation Procedures is the second Main Story mission of Control Resonant in the Contain the Crisis chapter. Now that you’ve been given the grand tour of everything you should know about the game, your next task for the FBC is to go to the Evacuation Site and search for the source of the tremors. This walkthrough for Evacuation Procedures includes instructions on how to reach the Evac Site and locate the source.

Use these links to jump to the section you need :

First things first, you should explore the inside of the Field Office for collectibles and other goodies. Check near the pillar by the stairs on the left side (when looking inside from the entrance) for a Wardrobe .

There are two Resource Boxes in the Field Office. The first is next to the table in the center. Check next to the table with the tape recorders for the second one.

Look on the table near the entrance for the collectible: Supply Distribution Check List .

You can read reports on Resonant Entities you defeat in Control Resonant in the Field Office. Investigate the table on the left side of the room (when looking in from the entrance) for the reports. At this point, you will have at least one report — on the Artist — to read: Field Research On Resonant Entity: RE-ZD .

Instant Photos - Freeze Frame Side Quest

Investigate the desk next to the Resource Crate for two Instant Photos. These photos offer clues on where you can go to unlock and continue the Side Quest, Freeze Frame .

For the mission, you first must head to the Evacuation Zone and, when there, find the source of the tremors. Open the map to view these two checkpoints. The Evacuation Zone Checkpoint is to the southeast . Head that way when you're ready to begin.

Now that you have a level 1 security keycard , you can enter and explore the Field Hospital and the Security Station outside of the office for more collectibles.

How to Unlock the Panopticon Service Request Side Story

When looking at the map, you may have spotted an icon for an Important Person near the Field Office. To find him, head east from the grounds outside the Field Office and approach the blue structure near the wall lit by a yellow light.

This is the Field Panopticon. Speak with the man named Langston inside, and he'll ask for your help, unlocking Panopticon Service Request . Near him is a collectible: Langston's Beat Poetry #27 .

Leave the security checkpoint, ignoring the rude guards, turn left, and follow the street until you spot a sign that points you to the Evacuation Zone . Follow the sign to the large wall. Enter the blue door on the left side.

Continue down the street until you're pulled into an Arena Encounter, this one introducing a new (and frankly annoying) Hiss type: Hiss Clusters . These floating balls of resonance heal nearby Hiss enemies. Target these first whenever they appear in a fight.

The fight unlocks a new ability: Dominance .

Dominance is a status you earn after Executing an enemy. When active, the status increases your Primary melee damage by a whopping 100% and your Secondary melee damage by 50% for a short amount of time. Killing enemies while Dominance is active also increases health drops. As a suggestion: an ideal way to get Dominance activated as soon as possible is to increase the Falter damage on a regular Hiss enemy and execute them, activating the buff. Afterward, you can use the increased melee damage on Hiss Heavy enemies. Rinse and repeat when the buff dissipates.

You can also find orbs of Dominance in the world. Grabbing one automatically applies Dominance.

Clear the Arena Encounter to unlock the passage to the Evacuation Zone. Enter the Evacuation Zone Checkpoint and make your way through the hallways.

Inside the checkpoint, you'll find a collectible on a table: Formal Complaint .

It's dark and a bit misty on the other side of the wall, showcasing how Zones can feel thematically different.

Check the nearby table for a collectible: Sinkhole Transcript .

Before continuing, you should locate the Mapping Pylon and get the map to the Evacuation Zone unlocked. To start, open the map and locate the Map Kit icon near the center of the zone.

First, you'll have to climb over the imposing wall separating you from the rest of the Zone.

Make your way over the wall by first climbing on top of the smaller building opposite of it.

Leap from the corner to the building with the floodlights .

Climb to the top and clamber over the rail to reach the top of the wall, where you'll find a frightening-looking sinkhole .

As Dylan calls Zoe, a massive tremor rocks the Zone, surprising him.

You can Report on the sinkhole to learn more about the anomaly.

Stepping past the sinkhole, you can look toward the Evac Site and report it to Zoe.

Drop from the wall and onto the streets below.

As you arrive, you'll likely be attacked by a new Hiss variant: Hiss Transporter . These rather bizarre Hiss enemies are tanky, but offer good rewards on defeat.

The Hiss Transporter is a Hiss enemy type in the shape of half a city bus that spawns multiple minions called Hiss Passengers to attack its prey. These enemies have large health pools, but contain specific weak spots you can exploit. Look on the sides of the bus for clumps of Hiss enemies. This is called a Breakable Part — in other words, a weak point. Attack the Breakable Part until it's destroyed to deal heavy damage and Falter to the enemy.

The Hiss Transporter teleports around the area, so keep an eye out for it after it disappears. Try to fight the bus while in the air, as its ground attack deals splash damage and burn. Continue the fight until the bus is destroyed. If you max out its Falter, you can execute it in a frankly cool way.

After the encounter is over, continue east until you arrive at a spot near the Map Kit . Look toward the line of buildings on the north side of the street. You must climb to the rooftop to locate the pylon. Use the overhang near the newsstand and leap across the gap to the lift and then clamber onto the building.

On the rooftop, you can find an Orientation Point and a Fast Travel Door .

Activate the Main Street Fast Travel Door

There's a Fast Travel Door on the rooftop near Main Street in the Evacuation Zone. Climb onto the building on the northern side of the street to find it.

To unlock the map, you'll need to locate the three Sensors near the Mapping Pylon. From the rooftop near the Fast Travel Door, you can spot one close by to the east .

Look across the street to the northwest to see the second on on a rooftop. Search for the blinking red light !

The third Sensor is to the north across an alley on another rooftop.

When all three are active, turn on the Mapping Pylon to unlock the Evacuation Zone Map . It's a small area, but there are plenty of places to explore.

With that done, continue southeast to the Evac Building . It's red and twisted on the map.

Vendors are shops where you can exchange Source for materials and other items. There's one near the Evacuation Zone Mapping Pylon. To find it, leave the Mapping Pylon and go east over the rooftops and drop into the alley behind the buildings.

There, you'll find an Orientation Point and an... Ice Cream Truck . If it has one of those freaky, half-melted-looking cartoon mascot heads, we’re in business!

Interact with the truck to enter the Vendor menu. Each Zone contains a Vendor to locate.

There's a Large Resource Crate you can find near the Evacuation Zone Mapping Pylon. Head east from the pylon and drop into the alley behind the buildings. Next, look behind the Vendor for the Large Resource Crate. Open it for x1 Health Upgrade Point .

As you approach, you'll enter another fight against a group of Heavies. Kill these ones to remove the barricades to the street-level stores.

When you get the chance, you should investigate the stores along the street for things like collectibles and Resource Crates. You can also find a puzzle to solve in an art gallery , which leads to an impressive reward.

You'll find an embarrassment of Hiss Heavies outside the door to the Evac Site. This can be a challenging fight, so you should take your time and try to pull as many enemies from the main group as possible and kill them before taking on the next.

You can approach the door after all the enemies are dispatched. Unfortunately, the doors are locked with a Hiss Barrier by three Hiss Nodes . You must follow the red trails in the air to locate the nodes keeping the doors shut and destroy them.

Resource Crate and Collectibles Locations

You can find two Resource Crates in small buildings outside the entrance to the Evac Site. Enter the building next to the row of flags and look for the crate in the corner. Check the shelf for a collectible: PR Video Screenplay .

The other Resource Crate can be found in the suspended yellow building closer to the Evac Site.

Head inside and look for the crate to the right of the blue lockers .

Investigate the inside of the building for collectibles:

PR Guidance Re: Patterned Subway Tunnels

When you're ready, look up to spot the red trails in the air. The first Hiss Node that must be destroyed to open the door can be found on the rectangular reflecting pool in front of the building. Look for it hovering over the pool, which is flanked on its lengthy side by flags.

After destroying the first node, you must follow the red trails to track down the other two, which are much further away. You can pick either trail to follow, but this guide will begin with the Hiss Node to the north .

Head north and climb onto the first set of buildings. From there, you should see a rooftop nestled between two taller buildings where the thread stops.

From here on, you will run across armored enemies. These foes have a layer of protection you must destroy to begin damaging their health. Armor is weak to Blunt damage, which you'll have thanks to your first chosen Combat Ability . If you picked Crush as a secondary Aberrant form, it'll also be very useful against armored foes .

Enemies are surrounding the Hiss Node, so you'll have to clear them out before getting close. When you're free, leap across the street to find the Node on the rooftop. These creatures are weak and cannot fight back, so you can wipe it out without much effort.

Return to the front of the Evac Building and prepare to search for the next Hiss Node.

The next Node is to the south , which you can see by following the second thread as it snakes its way toward some grim area emitting red light.

The Node is in a section behind tall buildings, and getting to it from the blocked part of the street may be a bit tricky.

Instead, turn right at the intersection before the barrier and then climb onto the building with an attached lift on the left side of the street .

From the top of that building, you can look into the alley below to see the thread disappearing into a storage area locked with a shutter . The rooftop of the building you're on also has an inactive Power Core and its cable is leading to the shutter. You'll have to power it up to access the Hiss Node.

Look west from the inactive Power Core Station near the northern Hiss Node for a rooftop with a Resource Crate.

Before doing that, however, you should clear all the enemies in the area, focusing on the Hiss Clusters that heal surrounding enemies first.

When you're done, return to the roof with the Power Core . Look toward the rooftops to the east and head that direction.

From the roof, look down onto the street and to the left to spot activated Power Core Stations attached to an obelisk.

Drop to the street, dash to the Power Cores, grab a charge, and follow the same path back to the rooftop with the inactive Power Core Station .

The shutter raises when the Power Core is activated. Drop down to the ground and destroy the Node to remove the barricade on the Evac Building.

Return to the front of the Evac Building, now free of the barricade. Pass the Orientation Point and head inside.

Check the storage box in front of the FBC van near the building entrance for the collectible: Mission Notes 1 .

The lobby of the building is a grisly scene, with FBC rangers dead and scattered. As you make your way inside, you can look at the body in the center of the hallway and make a report to Zoe .

Continue forward and stop when you arrive at the front desk. There's an elevator to the left for you to take, but you can explore the room for some goodies. There's also a Wardrobe sitting in the corner if you have an itch to change the fit.

The blue table next to the front desk has a collectible sitting by a lamp: Evacuation Pamphlet .

Between the Evac Building's front desk and a level 2 security door is a Resource Crate .

Next to the front desk of the Evac Building is a level 2 security door. You don't have access to this level of security yet, but you should keep the door in mind for the near future.

The front desk contains an FBC Terminal that, when activated, connects Dylan to a mysterious agent with a questionnaire. Completing the questionnaire is optional. Doing so rewards you with x1 Aberrant Shard , x1 Mourning Echo , and Source . The mini-game counts as a World Feat, which unlocks the Up to the Task achievement/trophy.

Enter the elevator and press the button for the 12th Floor . Zoe reaches out as you ascend, telling Dylan that she's been reading his file and isn't a fan of what she's found. A tremor suddenly rocks through the building, and Dylan momentarily flashes back to the time the Hiss invaded the Oldest House.

He returns to the real world as the elevator doors slide open, telling Zoe that his sudden lapse was from bad memories. Leave the elevator and activate the Orientation Point .

Next, follow the hallway to the left of the elevator. More bloodied corpses are strewn about, suggesting that these agents had it rough.

Continue down the bloody hallway until you reach the next room.

Enter the blue-lit room on the left side of the hallway and search one of the desks for the collectible: Sound Bath Sterilization Study .

As you enter, you'll spot a mass of Hiss enemies ranging from grunts to Heavies. All the exit doors are blocked by Hiss barriers, meaning you'll have to complete this Arena Encounter before you can continue.

The arena is a multi-floor section covered in enemies. Try to lure the Heavies away from one another, if possible. Taking on too many at once could be too challenging.

If you need health, you have two options. You can either look for Hiss grunts to kill or grab one of the several large Health Elements — keep an eye out for large, blue orbs !

Some of the enemies can walk on one of the walls of the room, making it so you'll have to leap toward them if you want to get within attacking range.

The barriers fall after all the Hiss Heavies are gone. Look on the second floor for a doorway lit by a bright blue light . That's where you want to go to continue the mission.

Zoe reaches out again as you travel down the hallway, asking how many people died , referring to the incident everyone in the FBC hints at when their anger or fear of Dylan is apparent. You get the chance to respond with three answers (or just silence). As before, it doesn't matter what responses you choose, as they won't alter the mission.

Walk onto the wooden scaffolding outside of the next room's window and turn right .

Leap over the gap to the scaffolding covered in blue tarp .

From there, look out and down from the gap to spot a ledge. Drop down and air-dash to reach it.

There's more scaffolding to reach out in the dark, but you can pause here for some goodies.

After reaching the scaffolding with the blue tarp after the first Arena Encounter, walk to the ledge near the next bit of scaffolding, turn right, and enter the open window. You'll find a Resource Crate in the corner.

Check the desk in the room with the Resource Crate for the collectible: An Internal FBC Comms Department Letter .

Leap over to the next platform, stop, and turn around to see another platform against the back wall. Jump over to it and turn around.

Run and leap from that platform over to the opening bathed in yellow light.

Enter the next room and look left for a Large Resource Crate .

After the platforming across the scaffolding, enter the next room to find a Large Resource Crate next to the door. Interact with it to get x1 Health Upgrade Point .

As you enter the next hallway, you're suddenly back in the Oldest House as Dylan, aka P6. Head forward, following the agents until they get trapped by a security door. The memory ends as you approach them.

You return to Dylan as he's standing in a hallway with Hiss-infected civilians. Enter the next area and activate the Orientation Point .

There's another elevator to take, but it's blocked by a Hiss Node . The red thread is passing through a locked door.

Look along the side of the wall for an open doorway and head inside. Progress through the room and then enter the hallway. Follow the red thread to find the Hiss Node .

Check the table under the posters for the collectible: Mission Notes 3 .

Destroy the Hiss Node to free the elevator.

In the corner next to the Hiss Node is a Resource Crate .

Head back to the large room, where you'll be attacked by a Hiss Heavy and some drones.

The Hiss Distorted is a floating-type Heavy enemy that can become nearly invisible. Attacking the foe breaks it out of its camouflage. Avoid its powerful breath, which fires out like a cone. These enemies will try to avoid combat by hiding, so watch for them where the air is distorted.

Enter the elevator and press the button for the 15th Floor .

536 . That's the number of dead reported by the FBC when the Hiss attacked the Oldest House, while Dylan was still a part of the flock. During the elevator ride, Dylan tells that to Zoe, showing he knows how devastating the attack was.

You once more enter Dylan's memory of seven years ago. Progress down the hallway, where FBC agents are fighting Hiss. Progress until you reach a door, where you return to the present. Zoe asks him what kind of person he is before ending the conversation. This section rewards you with Source and x1 Distorted Form .

Progress until you reach a red-lit room lined with cots and populated by floating bodies.

Check the desk near the wall for the collectible: Mission Notes 4 . On the cot next to the door is another collectible: A Note to Mom .

Continue into the hallway, where the tremors cause another memory. This time, it's of Arish grilling Dylan after the incident that left 536 people dead. You can respond , but it's garbled nonsense.

Continue after returning to the present. You'll finally discover the tremors' source. Keep pushing against the force of the tremors.

After a tremor, Dylan again returns to his past, this time in a linear sequence with him in his current look.

Progress through the FBC building a short way before returning, where you enter a large room full of Hiss-captured civilians : the source of the tremors.

Push forward and you'll see someone off in the distance. Soon, Arish can be heard. Keep moving to find the FBC Co-Director.

Interact with Arish to start a conversation . He asks why Dylan was freed, and you'll get the chance to respond. Feel free to pick whichever options sound best.

Arish agrees to leave with you after the conversation. The injector fluid keeping his mind from being taken over by the Hiss is getting low, which means he needs to be rescued right now.

Return to the elevator. Unfortunately, the doors are jammed, but Arish knows a trick to get them open. Press the button to get the elevator moving.

It stops before descending, and the doors open to reveal a Hiss Node keeping you grounded. Jump out and take care of the Node.

More threads appear, meaning you'll have to leave Arish to take care of things. But first, you can speak with Arish, who hands you a Level 2 Keycard .

Exit the elevator and follow the red trail to a nearby door with a Level 2 security lock. Use the card to open it and head on out.

Follow the thread to the large room from before. Drop down and kill the Hiss Node. After the short vision, you'll return to the present in the midst of another Arena Encounter .

Zoe reaches out after you clear the encounter. She reports that Arish was found alive, which means he made it down and out of the building. Zoe says she doesn't care about his past, as his actions have shown enough.

You can respond to this. Feel free to pick whichever option you think is best, as it won't change the mission.

Zoe tells you that your next goal is to return to the Field Office to speak with Arish. But first, you'll need to leave the Evac Building .

After getting the Level 2 Keycard and clearing the final Arena Encounter, look for a locked level 2 door on the top level of the arena room. Open it and head inside to find a Resource Crate and a collectible: Mission Notes 2 .

Return to the elevator and take it back down to the lobby. From here, you can exit the building or go investigate that level 2 room from earlier. You have to be a little curious, right?

Resource Crate and Arcade Cabinet Location

You can find a Resource Crate and an Arcade Cabinet behind the locked Level 2 security door in the lobby of the Evac Building. Unlock it after you get the Level 2 Keycard from Arish.

Using SHUM III Arcade Cabinets let you play a "unique, replayable challenge" that results in rewards based on how high you get on the leaderboards. You cannot use an Arcade Cabinet until the Zone it's in reaches a particular level. Each Zone has an Arcade Cabinet to discover!

Reach the exit to end Evacuation Procedures. The next Story Mission is Arish's Briefing .

articles.title: Lumen Sword (Lightsaber) Location - Crimson Desert Guide - IGN
articles.summary: The Lumen Sword is a unique weapon from Crimson Desert's Charting the Unknown DLC. It bears a striking resemblance to a Lightsaber from Star Wars, and
articles.body:
The Lumen Sword is a unique weapon from Crimson Desert 's Charting the Unknown DLC . It bears a striking resemblance to a Lightsaber from Star Wars, and this beam-based blade is one of the coolest weapons in the entire expansion. This page details exactly where to find the Lumen Sword underneath Crimson Desert's open ocean.

The Lumen Sword is found in an underwater cave in the South Sea . Start your search northeast of the letter A in "South Sea" on the map.

As you make your way beneath the waves, you'll spot a huge trench running north to south along the ocean floor. The top of the trench is roughly 50 meters below the surface.

That trench is where the cave is located. Swim down to the bottom, then follow it all the way to the south until you seemingly reach a dead end. The cave is hidden behind a coral formation in the southwestern corner.

Swim all the way through the lengthy cave tunnel and you'll end up in a cavern with some abandoned ruins. Your treasure is inside. Swim around to the front of the ruins, then enter the front door.

To find the chest inside the ruins, swim upward through the massive hole in the ceiling. In a corner on the destroyed third floor overgrown with algae, you'll find a treasure chest containing the Lumen Sword.

The Lumen Sword has 18 base attack and three Abyss Gear slots. It also comes equipped with Health Siphon Lv. 2 in the first Abyss Gear slot by default, which is a huge help.

articles.title: Morpha Boss Fight | Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake - IGN
articles.summary: In this Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake boss fight, we show you how to defeat Morpha, the Giant Aquatic Amoeba, at the end of the Water Temple. Morpha attacks by using its watery tendrils to slam into Link, so you'll need to stay mobile and avoid getting caught in its grasp. Use your Longshot to pull Morpha's exposed core out of its gelatinous body, then attack it with your sword while it's vulnerable.As the fight progresses, Morpha will become more aggressive, surrounding the arena with additional tendrils that make it harder to track down its core. Keep moving, watch for openings, and use the Longshot to pull Morpha into a safe position before attacking. Defeat the creature to earn a Heart Container and restore the waters of Lake Hylia!

articles.body:
Explore the Spirit Temple in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake with this complete walkthrough! This massive dungeon requires Link to travel between the past and future, exploring its Child and Adult eras to uncover the secrets hidden within the Evil Desert Colossus. Play as Child Link to navigate the temple's western wing, solve puzzles, defeat enemies, and obtain the Silver Gauntlets before returning as Adult Link to explore the eastern wing.

Follow along as we find the Dungeon Map, Compass, Silver Gauntlets, Mirror Shield, and Boss Key while collecting Small Keys, Gold Skulltulas, and the final Piece of Heart. We'll also cover the temple's trickier puzzles, including the Anubis encounters, rolling boulders, mirror and light puzzles, and Iron Knuckle battles, before making our way to the final showdown against Twinrova.

articles.title: 13-Year-Old Tekken Player Who Looks Just Like a Young Kazuya Mishima Defeats Fighting Game Pro in Stacked Tournament
articles.summary: A 13-year-old Tekken player went viral over the weekend for beating a seasoned pro in a competitive tournament — all while boasting a hairstyle that looked just like Kazuya Mishima’s.
articles.body:
A 13-year-old Tekken player went viral over the weekend for beating a seasoned pro in a competitive tournament — all while boasting a hairstyle that looked just like Kazuya Mishima’s.

Thaiger Uppercut (TGU) is a major fighting game tournament that takes place in Thailand each fall. It’s known for drawing some of the best talent across multiple titles from around the world, with established players flocking to the competition for fame, glory, and of course, prize money.

This year, however, an unexpected combatant emerged: 13-year-old Martinski, a Tekken player from the Philippines, left audiences stunned after taking out Pinya, a well-known Japanese Tekken pro who has been competing at a top level since the days of Tekken 7 .

HUGE round in pools. 📺 // #TEKKEN8 #TGU2026 — Bandai Namco Esports (@BNEesports) November 14, 2026

HUGE round in pools. 📺 // #TEKKEN8 #TGU2026

Martinski beat Pinya 2-0 in a stunning show of strength, knocking his opponent to the losers’ bracket. However, it wasn’t just the absurd talent he displayed at such a young age that made him go viral within the fighting game community; he also styled his hair to look like Kazuya Mishima, the Tekken series’ former protagonist-turned-antagonist.

In fact, Martinski made it to the Top 48 — a solid feat for a player of any caliber, but an especially impressive achievement for one so young. Looking at Start.gg, the 13-year-old competitor finished in 25th place out of 187 other players

Over on X/Twitter, Martinski spoke about his results, saying he was “proud of this run and grateful for the experience” and that “there's always something to take away from every tournament.”

@ELITE_Martinski IS INSANE AT TEKKEN 8 AND ONLY 13 YEARS OLD. CONGRATULATIONS FOR MAKING IT INTO TOP 48 AT TGU 🇹🇭 — Roo Kang (@rookang1) November 14, 2026

@ELITE_Martinski IS INSANE AT TEKKEN 8 AND ONLY 13 YEARS OLD. CONGRATULATIONS FOR MAKING IT INTO TOP 48 AT TGU 🇹🇭

Martinski also competed in a 3v3 teams bracket under the name ‘Martinski’s Magic Light Team.’ The group finished 9th out of 24 total teams.

Martinski’s performance at TGU highlights a growing trend within the fighting game community; young players are becoming increasingly successful in tournaments, particularly where Tekken 8 and Street Fighter 6 are concerned.

For example, 16-year-old Neia stunned audiences after making it to the Top 24 for Tekken 8 at Evo France, one of the most stacked tournaments of the season. She even beat established pros Hakim ‘Skywalker’ Touré and Jonathan ‘Tibetano’ Medina to get there, and has been a rising star in the scene ever since then.

And in Street Fighter 6, 17-year-old Chilean player Blaz recently helped his team win the Street Fighter League Americas Finals — but he’s been knocking heads since he was just 15, and even got second place at Capcom Cup 11 a few months after his 16th birthday. Another young Chilean talent, Craime, made the Top 8 at Evo Las Vegas this year at 15 years old, but has been competing in tournaments since he was 13. He famously won the Esports World Cup for Street Fighter 6 earlier this year, cementing his status as a major threat for the competition.

I got the chance to interview Blaz after his monumental victory with team 2Game after the SFL Americas Finals last weekend, where he explained why modern games like Street Fighter 6 attract younger players and why LATAM is such a strong region right now.

articles.title: 007 Fans React to Robert Pattinson's James Bond Casting
articles.summary: Robert Pattinson is the next James Bond, which means there is no shortage of opinions flying around the internet about this news.
articles.body:
Robert Pattinson is the next James Bond , which means there's no shortage of opinions flying around the internet about this news.

It was confirmed today that Robert Pattinson has been cast as James Bond , with reports saying his deal was squared away as recently as yesterday. Pattinson's casting was reportedly last-minute , as the producers have been working through an array of actors for Bond all year long. Pattinson only submitted himself for the part a few weeks ago when filming on The Batman Part 2 briefly paused . As a result, it shook up the group of finalists , which reportedly included names like Jack Lowden and Callum Turner.

With Pattinson stealing the gig with a buzzer-beater screen test and snagging a lucrative deal , it's no surprise that reactions have been animated, to say the least. The biggest takeaway for many is that Pattinson is playing both Bond and Batman, seemingly at the same time. Some joked that this is rather greedy of him, since he's an extremely accomplished actor and is hogging up some of the best parts.

The Next James Bonds Who Never Played 007

"Yo, I'm actually sick bro; that motherf**ker is gonna finish with a top 5 filmography ever," joked one fan .

"Being both Batman and James Bond, this is the greed they talk about in the Bible," said another .

Others think this may be a sign that his days as Batman are coming to an end. Of course, DC Studios bosses James Gunn and Peter Safran were just ousted from the company and replaced by a newer, cheaper alternative. It seems like Skydance may want to save on costs and also make more accessible movies, and it's unclear if the highly-expensive, dark, gritty Matt Reeves-directed Batman films will allow for that. It may be feasible to complete a trilogy if Reeves can get a third movie turned around quickly, but it took five years between the first two movies, and the sequel has experienced some setbacks, as well.

"He’s done as Batman after Part II, obviously," suggested an observer .

Although it's not impossible for an actor to do multiple movies in a year or in quick succession, Batman and Bond are extremely physical roles that demand a lot from an actor. Depending on schedules, it means Pattinson would have to constantly stay in tip-top shape, and he may not have time to do smaller films like he did with Primetime and The Drama this year.

The Batman Part 2 started shooting in late May or early June, and is expected to continue filming into early 2027. A Bond film has a similar extended schedule that also takes actors around the globe, limiting opportunities to do other projects. Maybe Pattinson will find a way to juggle both roles if DC wants a third installment, but the jury is out.

Although Pattinson's casting has been met with a lot of hype, others aren't as sold, given that he's become known for taking weirder roles. He's also been exposed to the audience a lot in the last year.

"Love Pattinson, but c'mon man, y'all have to cast unknown actors for some stuff," said a user on X . "I don’t see him fitting Bond.

"I just don’t see it," said another user . "Looks more like a villain than Bond"

Ultimately, though, Pattinson's casting as Bond is being met with a lot more enthusiasm than his initial casting announcement for Batman was. Although he'd turned in strong performances in films like Good Time before Batman, he was best known for being a sparkly, moody vampire in Twilight. For some, that didn't jive with their idea of Batman. Since then, he has been in a number of respected films that have reached wider audiences, including The Odyssey and soon-to-be Dune Part 3.

There's currently no release date for Pattinson's first Bond outing, though some expect it will release in 2028 with a 2027 shoot date in mind. Director Denis Villeneuve will likely be badgered with questions about the project when promoting Dune 3 in the next month, so we may get some more ideas of what to expect soon.

Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team. He covers all things entertainment, including gaming, film, and more. You can find him on Twitter @Cade_Onder.

articles.title: Why Robert Pattinson Likely Can’t Play Batman and James Bond Together
articles.summary: Robert Pattinson taking on the James Bond role probably means that The Batman: Part II is his final outing as the Dark Knight. Here's why Pattinson likely can't (or won't) play both roles going forward.
articles.body:
Our long international nightmare is finally over. Amazon MGM Studios has selected a new actor to play James Bond, and it’s none other than former Twilight star Robert Pattinson . Despite being an actor who tends to prioritize quirky indie roles (while throwing in the occasional blockbuster for good measure), Pattinson has signed on to star in another of the film world’s biggest franchises.

This means Pattinson will now be in the unique position of playing both Batman and Bond. But can that arrangement last long-term, or is this a sign that the actor's days in Gotham City are coming to an end? Unfortunately, we think the latter possibility is the more likely one. Here’s why Pattinson is probably trading one superhero role for another, and why The Batman: Part II is almost certainly the end of the road for that particular series.

DC Universe: Every Upcoming Movie and TV Show

Pattinson’s Bond casting is certainly an interesting and unexpected development. MGM has tended to focus on up-and-coming actors for the various Bond films, whether it was a then little-known Sean Connery in 1962’s Dr. No or Daniel Craig in 2006’s Casino Royale. Early on, it seemed Amazon was going to continue operating under this philosophy , with relatively lesser-known actors like Callum Turner and Josh O’Connor emerging as frontrunners. Apparently, the studio had a change of heart.

Compared to past Bonds, Pattinson is already a huge name with a wide resume and multiple key franchises under his belt. This is basically like if the studio hired Christian Bale to take on the Bond role after 2005’s Batman Begins. It’s a lot of cinematic responsibility for one actor to shoulder.

Is there a world where Pattinson continues to juggle the dual responsibilities of playing Batman and Bond? Perhaps. The actor certainly seems to like keeping busy as an actor. In 2026 alone, he’s starred in The Drama, The Odyssey, and Primetime, and we still have his sci-fi heel turn in Dune: Part 3 coming up in December.

Still, it seems unlikely that even an actor as prolific as Pattinson is able or willing to juggle both James Bond and Bruce Wayne at the same time. Again, both roles are massive responsibilities that each require a huge time commitment, including the massive promotional push that comes after filming has wrapped.

Look at what happened to Mahershala Ali when he signed on to do Blade for Marvel Studios. Even though that project never came to be, Ali had to turn down a lot of work because he was so focused on training for the role and developing the film. Or look at Xochitl Gomez, who basically stopped getting offers after appearing in 2022’s Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness because casting agents assumed she was too tied up in the Marvel machine.

Being James Bond and being Batman are both comparable. Each role can keep the actor tied up for months or years at a time. The odds that one franchise might interfere with the other in the years ahead seem rather high. With many years already having passed since 2021’s No Time to Die, Amazon MGM likely wants to push forward quickly with the reboot.

We highly doubt an actor like Pattinson, who clearly values his freedom to pursue interesting and unusual projects in this post-Twilight phase of his career, has any real desire to attempt to juggle both Batman and Bond simultaneously. This Bond news simply signals the idea that Pattinson feels his days as Batman are coming to an end. Currently, Steven Soderbergh has stepped in to finish production on The Batman: Part II while Matt Reeves deals with a personal matter. Once that wraps in late 2026 or early 2027, we’re guessing Pattinson will most likely hang up the cape and cowl and move on to other projects, one of which is the long-awaited James Bond reboot. He’s just trading one blockbuster franchise for another.

The Problem With Matt Reeves’ Batman Universe

Mind you, Pattinson may not be moving on from Batman out of a waning interest in the character, but simply due to the reality on the ground. There’s a lot currently working against this iteration of the Batman franchise. As mentioned, director Matt Reeves has had to step away from production due to personal problems. It’s unclear how heavy a role Reeves will have in the film’s post-production. We’re sure a third movie isn’t high on his list of priorities at the moment.

The likelihood is that if the newly merged Skydance even wants a The Batman: Part III, they’d have to push forward without Reeves as writer or director if they don’t want another long gap between sequels. Do fans actually want a Reeves-less The Batman: Part III? Would Pattinson even be interested in returning in that eventuality? Losing this series’ defining creative voice seems like too big a hurdle to cross.

And that’s assuming Skydance wants The Batman: Part III to happen at all. Right now, we have no idea what direction they’re taking with the DC line after firing James Gunn and Peter Safran. We’d argue the current DCU continuity should stay in place , but there’s no guarantee that’ll happen. All we can say for sure is that Batman, easily the most bankable DC character in existence, is going to be a major priority for the studio going forward.

It stands to reason that executives aren’t thrilled with how long it’s taken to put out a sequel to 2022’s The Batman. And they’re probably also not fond of the fact that Reeves’ The Batman movies exist in their own little universe, while the Batman of Gunn and Safran’s DCU is still an enigma after all these years. Historically, DC has always shied away from allowing multiple incarnations of characters to coexist in live-action, and that approach may continue under Skydance.

That leaves Skydance with two options - either focus on the Pattinson/Reeves universe as the sole Batman going forward, or reboot the character and pivot to something relatively more family-friendly and with more box office potential. We tend to think the company would opt for the latter. Incoming DC Studios head Jeremy Latcham seems to prefer more uplifting and family-friendly movies, and it would be in keeping with Paramount’s recent approach to the TMNT franchise .

Basically, between Reeves’ ongoing personal problems and the general direction of the wind at Skydance, there’s a good chance that there’s no future for the “ Batman Epic Crime Saga ” after The Batman: Part II finally arrives in 2028. We’re not holding our breath for The Penguin Season 2 either. That’s likely why Pattinson agreed to play James Bond. He sees the writing on the wall for his version of Batman, and he’s moving on to greener pastures.

It’s a shame in many ways, but we suspect that Skydance’s loss will be Amazon MGM’s gain in the years to come. Pattinson may not be the most bold or exciting choice to play Bond, but we can’t imagine he won’t do well in the role. There are far worse outcomes for this venerable franchise than to have Pattinson and director Denis Villeneuve rebooting it for a new era.

articles.title: Nvidia Reportedly Uninterested in Bringing Jensen Huang Back as CEO
articles.summary: Nvidia is reportedly not entertaining the idea of bringing Jensen Huang back as CEO following rumors that his allies had established a "war room" to push for his reinstatement.
articles.body:
Nvidia is reportedly not entertaining the idea of bringing Jensen Huang back as CEO following rumors that his allies had established a "war room" to push for his reinstatement.

The latest turn in the tech giant's whirlwind week arrived yesterday, when the Financial Times reported that the company's ex-boss had supported efforts from his friends in Silicon Valley to see him brought back into the fold . One source said these allies had assembled a "war room" to lay the foundation for his return, but it now seems those efforts may have been for naught.

The Nvidia board of directors is not considering reinstating Huang as CEO after he resigned from his position Thursday, November 12, one source told CNBC . Instead, company leadership is focused on the ongoing investigation launched after Huang confirmed he had an affair with a woman whom members of the U.S. government believed to be a Chinese spy on November 8.

The report states Nvidia hired law firm Wachtell Lipton to look into his relationship with the individual and how it may have compromised company secrets and/or national security. A message from the board added it had "no reason to believe that either national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised" when announcing the investigation last week.

One of the supposed goals of Huang's secret war room of Silicon Valley supporters was to gain White House support for the reinstatement – and it's a plan that seems to have panned out. U.S. President Donald Trump told reporters today (via Bloomberg ) that he "would not mind" seeing the embattled tech leader return.

"I would not mind. I would not mind that," he said. "I threw out the name of Tim Cook , but I would say that Jensen's reinstatement… I think he learned a big lesson. I guess maybe one lesson's more important than another, but I would certainly not mind seeing that."

Huang and Nvidia are now trying to pick up the pieces after the investigation began last week. The story so far has seen tech billionaire Elon Musk publicly back Huang , with some Nvidia employees saying they'd like him reinstated, too. Additional reports have said the former CEO had additional affairs with not one but two of his subordinates .

articles.title: Alienware's 39" 5K Monitor With RGB Stripe Tandem OLED Technology Hits a New Price Low for Black Friday
articles.summary: A monitor that excels at both gaming and workstation productivity.
articles.body:
Earlier this year, Dell announced the "world's first 39" 5K monitor with RGB stripe tandem OLED technology." You can finally get your hands on one. The new Alienware AW3926QW has just been listed at Dell for $1,099.99 with free delivery. For Black Friday, Best Buy is offering it for $100 less . This monitor excels at both gaming and workstation use thanks to its unparalleled text clarity. It also comes with a 3 year warranty that covers OLED burn-in.

Save $100 Off the Alienware 39" 5K OLED Gaming Monitor

39" Alienware AW3926QW 5K RGB Stripe Tandem OLED Gaming Monitor

The Alienware AW3926QW has no lack of features that make it stand out from the crowd, but perhaps its most impressive technology is the RGB stripe tandem OLED panel. Tandem OLED stacks multiple OLED layers on top of each other instead of a single layer. Tandem OLED is better than other OLED panels because: 1) it's much brighter (the AW3926QW in particular has a very impressive 1,300 nits of peak brightness) and 2) it's less prone to burn-in.

The AW3926QW doubles down on this with new RGB stripe technology. Whereas traditional tandem OLEDs use white pixels, RGB stripe tandem OLED breaks the color down further into vertically aligned red, green, and blue pixels. This reduces color fringing and in turn significantly improves text clarity. It goes without saying that there are obvious benefits here for both gaming and productivity purposes alike.

Tandem and RGB stripe technologies aside, the AW3926QW is also Alienware's first 5K OLED monitor. With an impressive 5120 x 2160 resolution, this 39" monitor boasts a pixel density of 143ppi. That's even sharper than an already impressive 32" 4K monitor, with its pixel density of 138ppi. A 39" monitor is pretty wide, so the AW3926QW employs a 1500R curve to balance it out. 1500R is pretty moderate as far as curved monitors go, so although you'll be able to see the entire monitor within your field of view, it won't significantly distort peripheral images.

OLED monitors are known for their extreme fast response time and perfect black levels, making them ideal for gaming. The AW3926QW ups the ante with its 165Hz refresh rate at 4K and support for AMD FreeSync Premium Pro and NVIDIA G-Sync compatibility. It has both DisplayPort 2.1 and HDMI 2.1 ports so you'll be able to connect it to just about any modern day graphics card without the need for adapters.

Alienware also backs the monitor up with a 3 year warranty that covers OLED burn-in.

articles.title: Blizzard Tries 2 World of Warcraft Dungeon Fixes Over the Weekend to Stop Boosting Services
articles.summary: World of Warcraft Forever has now been out for a couple of weeks, and it's had a remarkably smooth launch. But now that players are starting to get to high enough levels to engage with dungeons, Blizzard is trying to nail down exactly how dungeons should reward players.
articles.body:
World of Warcraft Forever has now been out for a couple of weeks, and it's had a remarkably smooth launch. But now that players are starting to level up enough to engage with dungeons, Blizzard is trying to nail down exactly how dungeons should reward players.

Over the weekend, Blizzard pushed out a November 13 hotfix that made it so if there's any player in a group that's too high of a level to earn experience from monsters, no one in that group gets experience. The goal seems to be to get rid of boosting, where one high-level player can carry a group of players through dungeons to level them up quickly. But that solution backfired.

The problem is that in a lot of Forever's dungeons, there's a wide level range, so players on the high end of that range ended up accidentally nullifying everyone else's experience in the dungeon. That even happened to me on Saturday when trying to run Excavation Site with a level 37 player in my group.

The next day, Blizzard admitted that hotfix went too far. On the WoW Forever forums, community manager Kaivax posted , saying, "Yesterday, we updated dungeon play so that experience granted by an enemy in an instance is nullified if a high level player is in the group and enemy is trivial to that player. For some dungeons, the new restriction missed the mark because of the overall level range of the enemies in the dungeon."

Instead, Blizzard changed the way the restriction works. Rather than basing it on whether or not an enemy is "trivial" to any of the players, there's now a flat level difference restriction on experience. As Kaivax puts it, "We’ve just deployed a further change to this restriction, making it so that the XP nullification only kicks in when the high-level player is more than 12 levels above the level of the enemies."

For those who are just trying to do dungeons as they naturally come up while questing, the latest update should completely fix the issue, while also preventing boosters from powering people through the game. After all, Blizzard is dead-set on encouraging players to level out in the world, and is apparently not afraid of using some heavy-handed tactics to do so.

This also isn’t the first time that Blizzard has needed to adjust dungeon experience. Back when the WoW Forever beta first opened, the company severely limited the amount of XP you get from dungeons, only to buff it last week – even if it’s still far below what you’d earn in Classic . Blizzard has also changed the way gold is earned , in order to stop people from feeling like they had to hoard quest turn-ins for when they hit max level.

articles.title: Gerudo Proving Grounds Walkthrough - The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Guide - IGN
articles.summary: The Gerudo Proving Grounds (also known as the Gerudo Training Grounds) is an optional dungeon "mini-game" that Link can test his might at in The
articles.body:
The Gerudo Proving Grounds (also known as the Gerudo Training Grounds) is an optional dungeon "mini-game" that Link can test his might at in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake. Located near the Gerudo Fortress in the west of Hyrule, it can only be reached once Link is an adult, and after he has proven himself to the Gerudo people and earned the Gerudo Pass.

The Gerudo Proving Grounds is comprised of several challenging rooms featuring puzzles and dangerous enemies, many of which award Small Keys. These keys can be used to unlock a series of doors in a large central chamber, leading to the true reward of the Proving Grounds: The Ice Arrows.

While it's possible to obtain the rewards from this mini-dungeon with only a few key tools, completing every chamber and opening all optional locked doors will require Link to obtain the Silver Gauntlets at the Spirit Temple on the far side of Mirage Desert.

From the Gerudo Fortress, head along the large road to the southeast toward the horseback archery training course, and you'll find an attendant in front of a large gate who will tell you about the grounds. As an outsider, it will cost you 30 Rupees each time you want to enter the grounds and pick up where you left off.

As you enter, you'll find yourself in a large area with three large lion-shaped doors. The central door leads to the treasure room, which is filled with locked doors that progress in a maze-like fashion toward the center where the prize is.

If you inspect the room closely, you'll also find a hidden eye target above the entrance, which can be shot to reveal a Small Treasure Chest with a Blue Rupee!

The rest of the mini-dungeon is configured in a wide circle, with both doors leading to a series of rooms that connect at the top and loop around the central prize chamber, meaning you can head through in whichever order you wish.

Starting with the door to the right, you'll enter an arena lined by a wall of fire, pitting you against two Dinolfos and a Beamos sentry in the middle. If you can, quickly dash past the lizards to toss a bomb or set a Bombchu off at the Beamos before it can hamper you while you try and focus on the main adversaries. Note that if you've already completed the Spirit Temple at this point, you can also reflect the Beamos' laser with your Mirror Shield, and even redirect it at the Dinolfos!

If not, bait out their leaping sword attacks to render them vulnerable to counters, or use Deku Nuts to stun them and then follow up with a Spin Attack, as they have little defense to speak of. Defeating the pair will drop a small Treasure Chest down holding your first of many Small Keys.

Heading north, you'll enter the lava-filled room that will require the Goron Tunic unless you want to start burning alive! Five silver Rupees will appear in this obstacles course you'll need to traverse, with the first one just beside you.

With several Rupees floating in the air over the lava, having the Hover Boots in this room is recommended, though not entirely required, as you can also hookshot to several points along the walls. The second silver Rupees is between the middle and right ledge.

To the left is a high ledge with a door, and below it on one side is a switch, and on the far side, a third silver Rupee is engulfed in flames. Stepping on the switch turns the fire off for a short duration, but you'll still need a way over. Look for the nearby wall panel featuring a blue square, and play the Song of Time to create several large blocks. You can dash across to one using the Hover Boots and then climb up over the ledge to hover across to the Rupee before the fire returns.

Carefully hover back over to the ledge with the blue blocks and drop down to hover over to the north, and jump up the ledges to grab the fourth silver Rupee, and hookshot to the high ledge to pick up the final silver Rupee, opening the gate to the right.

Enter this room next, and you'll find a group of blue blocks in the center of the room. Playing the Song of Time will make them vanish, revealing a deep whirlpool below. For this, you'll need to ditch the Goron Tunic and Hover Boots, and instead adorn the Zora Tunic and Iron Boots instead.

First, focus on dropping to the very bottom, and using your Hookshot to defeat the two Shellblades in the corners of the room, so you can focus on grabbing all five silver Rupees down here.

One is located in the very center, and two others can be grabbed by using the hookshot targets along the walls. For the final two, you'll need to alternate your iron boots usage to swim up the corners and "fall" into them.

Grab all five, and a new gate will unlock revealing a small Treasure Chest with a second Small Key.

Return to the lava-filled room, where there are two other doors. The door above the blue blocks leads to the central prize chamber, and three small Treasure Chests holding three Arrows, five Bombchus, and a Small Key. However, we recommend that you DO NOT unlock the doors to the left, as they simply create a shortcut back to the entrance room, and effectively waste two keys!

This time, go to the far door on the north side of the lava-filled room on a high ledge. In the next room, you'll find several fiery enemies in a room filled with large stone statues. Use your bow to defeat the Fire Keese, and Megaton Hammer to squash the Fire Slugs. This will unlock a small Treasure Chest holding five Arrows.

To unlock the chest in the middle, use your Megaton Hammer to slam away all the segmented statues bordering the room. On the right side, you'll find one statue was on top of a small recess with a switch you can stand on to douse the flames, giving you access to your next Small Key.

Note that the far door leading out is barred, but you can unlock it by looking for an eye switch that was obscured by another statue along the wall. However, we'll be returning to to the entrance hall and taking the left path this time.

Entering the door on the left from the entrance, you'll be locked into an arena with several large stone pillars against two Stalfos. They'll wait to attack you one on one, and you can use this to your advantage by baiting out their jump attacks. Just be sure you have clear view of them and that they don't ambush you from behind the stone pillars. The sand can also make dodging difficult, so don't be afraid to lure them back to the stone platforms for better footing.

Defeat the pair, and you'll earn another Small Key.

Heading into the next room, you'll be in a large sloping area with a steady stream of boulders rolling down the sides, and five silver Rupees to claim. The path isn't as straightforward as you might think, as there are many hidden flame wall traps.

Grab the first silver Rupee in the back left corner after a boulder rolls by then quickly sprint back.

The second silver Rupee in the opposite corner has a flame wall in front of it, requiring you to move up the slope and then run down to claim it. From here, you can bypass the flame wall by using the hookshot target on the ceiling above the entry door, where the third silver Rupee is.

If you have the Longshot, you can reach the high ledge at the front from down below where the fourth silver Rupee is, otherwise you'll need to quickly run up the slope on the left.

Then, run up the remainder of the left slope to find the last silver Rupee in alcove blocked by another flame wall blocking the exit door, which you can bypass using the hookshot target on the ceiling.

This opens up the next room ahead, where you'll be locked into combat with two Wolfos and two White Wolfos. Try to remain mobile as you strafe around the outer part of the room to keep as many of them in view as possible. Backflip away from their swipes before jumping in on their exposed backs, and then reposition to re-target the next attacker.

Defeating the group will unlock a small Treasure Chest holding a Blue Rupee.

Now, you'll be met with two paths: One is a fake door you'll want to destroy, and then use the Lenses of Truth to reveal a hole in the wall above you can Hookshot to and find the true doorway out.

The second path is one that requires the Silver Gauntlets from the Spirit Temple to open, but if you don't have that yet you can skip it if you open the correct doors later, or just want to come back later. If you have the gauntlets, push the large black rock forward into a hole, revealing a sealed door. However, with the Lenses of Truth, you can spot an eye switch above it that you can shoot to open the door.

This leads to a gruesome room filled with Like Likes! Engage these foes cautiously, and use your long ranged tools to keep them from swarming you, or use the Hookshot to stun them before following up with a big spin attack.

You'll find that this room is full of a small Treasure Chests, but not all are worthwhile:

The one visible chest at the back of the room is actually an ice trap.

Defeating all the Like Likes causes a chest to appear by the front holding a Red Rupee.

You can bomb a cracked wall nearby to reveal another chest with five Bombs.

On the left side, there's an eye target on the high wall that will reveal a chest with a Business Scrub Seed.

The only real one you need can only be found with the Lenses of Truth, and holds the Small Key you're looking for.

Taking the door through the invisible gap in the wall above the fake door, leading to a large circular lava-filled room that you'll need the Goron Tunic to survive in.

Drop down below, and shoot the eye target above the door down here, which connect to the other path and that room with all the statues you needed to bash with the hammer. Hitting the eye target here will raise a large rock slab out of the lava covered in eye targets, while spinning the lower platform to create moving targets.

You'll need to hit all of the eye targets while moving along the platform, which will drain the lava, unseal the door above, and reveal a small Treasure Chest with a new Small Key.

To reach the high walkway again, look to the side of the door you just unsealed to spot a gust of straw, and play the Scarecrow's Song to summon Pierre. You can now hookshot up to enter the door, which leads back to the central prize chamber. This part however is an isloated area above it, and features one last small Treasure Chest with a Small Key to claim.

Now it's time to return back to the entrance and enter the central prize chamber. Before touching anything, check your total amount of keys:

If you only have 7 Keys, do NOT open the door on the right .

If you have 8 Keys, you can open the door on the right .

Accessing the door on the right will lead to a second locked door that serves as a shortcut to the lava-filled room you had to find silver Rupees in, as well as the few other small chests we opened previously. This chamber between doors also has a mesh wall you can climb up to a top floor, where you can spot a chest that can be accessed from the other side.

With this in mind, open the door on the left, and look for another mesh wall you can climb with an illusory ceiling leading to the second floor that hides the final key.

From this point on, as long as you have six keys left, you can open all the remaining doors leading to the center, each of which have their own small Treasure Chests containing a Purple Rupee, Red Rupee, and Three Arrows.

The last chamber in the very middle holds a large Treasure Chest, and within you'll find the main prize: The Ice Arrows.

With these, you'll be able to charge your magic power to unleash an icy blast at enemies and freeze many of them in place. This even has an added bonus effect on a few types of enemies:

Shoot at a Freezard to instantly melt and defeat it

Shoot at moving spike traps to freeze them in a harmless block of ice for an extended period

If you've gotten creative and haven't even completed earlier dungeons, you can even use it on Volvagia in the Fire Temple to stun and ground the foe by aiming at his head!

articles.title: How to Repair Guns - Rob Run Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Your guns and weaponry gradually break down as you use them in Rob Run. It's a way to ensure you're consistently spending money and have something to
articles.body:
Your guns and weaponry gradually break down as you use them in Rob Run . It's a way to ensure you're consistently spending money and have something to use as you continue to finance your criminal activities. As it stands, Rob Run is in early access, and gun repairs are not available in the current build. However, the development team has promised that they're on the way. Here's what we know about repairing guns and when it's coming to Rob Run.

The development team behind Rob Run did address this with its community. The team shared in a Steam news post released on Nov. 13 about the community's most frequently asked questions and addressed that gear durability degrading is a starting choice to help balance the in-game economy.

However, weapon and gear repair will be available in a future update. The team is planning to do it in a future weapon repair mechanic update.

A weapon's durability decreases every time you die. If you go down multiple times, expect the weapon to not function as well as it does when it's above the threshold. Whenever you defeat another player, you can inspect the durability by highlighting it while it's in your inventory. It will be under the weapon's magazine size and weapon range graph.

For now, though, any weapon that loses durability cannot be repaired in Rob Run. If there's a weapon you want to continue using, store it somewhere in your home, and wait for the weapon repair kits to become available. We'll also be updating this section when we learn more about how this gameplay mechanic works for everyone.

articles.body:
If you enjoy listening to music while you run or work out, then this headset should be on your radar. As part of Best Buy's first round of Black Friday deals, you can pick up the Shokz OpenRun Pro Open-Ear Wireless Sport Headphones - only in black - for just $89.99 with free shipping after a 44% off instant discount. All other colorways are currently on sale for $130, so stick with rose gold for the biggest savings.

44% Off Shokz OpenRun Pro Sport Headphones

Shokz OpenRun Pro Open-Ear Wireless Bone Conduction Sport Headphones

The OpenRun Pro looks like a neckband style headphone except that a lightweight titanium band connecting the two ear pieces wraps around the back of your head instead of resting on your neck. This design does an excellent job of keeping everything in place, perfect for active exercise.

Instead of the traditional method of sending sound vibrations to your eardrums, the OpenRun Pro uses bone conduction technology to send vibrations through your cheekbones directly to your inner ear. As such, the headphones are actually placed in front of your ear instead of on your ear. The biggest advantage is that you can fully hear your surroundings; if you like running on streets, for example, you'll be aware of everything that's going on around you while your music is playing.

The Shokz OpenRun are the best earbuds for exercise

I have a pair of AirPods Pro that I use regularly, but I always set them aside for the OpenRun Pros when I run. The Transparency mode on the AirPods Pro does work well for most situations, but they still can't compare to the awareness you get without having any buds plugging up your ears. In my experience these headphones stay in place extremely well and the sound quality is great compared to other sport headphones I've tried.

articles.title: Welcome Home 3.1 Patch Notes - Hello Kitty Island Adventure Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Hello Kitty Island Adventure's 3.1 update is a follow-up to the major Welcome Home update, version 3.0, which released earlier in 2026. This update
articles.body:
Hello Kitty Island Adventure's 3.1 update is a follow-up to the major Welcome Home update , version 3.0, which released earlier in 2026. This update released for Apple Arcade on November 4, 2026, and is planned to debut on other platforms in the future.

The update adds Character Homes for the Friendship Island residents who didn't get one in Version 3.0! Of course, making new homes for your friends lets you level up your own Island Home as well, with more customization options for the exterior of your house, including Landscapes. Plus, travel more quickly with new Ziplines, discover an all-new part of Merry Meadow , meet another of Keroppi's friends, and more!

This guide will cover everything added in Hello Kitty Island Adventure's Version 3.1 update.

The quest to build Character Homes for all of your friends continues! As of the 3.1 update, you can make homes for Retsuko , Wish me mell , My Sweet Piano , TOPHAT , Big Challenges , Kiki , Lala , and Moppu ! You'll need to have built the first set of homes before you can move on to the second, so check out our guides to the Quests Dream Homes Part 1 , Part 2 , and Part 3 .

Pick out the perfect plots for your friends, then build Foundations using Cornerstones. Then, head over to the Drafting Table to make a Home-in-a-Box using each resident's favorite items. Completing Character Homes might even lead to some special presents from your friend Marroncream !

The Burrow Borough is a hidden part of Merry Meadow that you can discover together with Marroncream! Here, you'll find more plots for building homes for your friends, as well as a Dye Shop that lets you purchase Dye Pouches in a variety of colors. Complete the Quest A Hole in the Wall to unlock this cozy new area!

The 3.1 update made traveling around Friendship Island faster than ever before with Zooplines, a series of miniature Ziplines located throughout the island. There's even one all the way up on Icy Peak!

There are a total of 19 Zooplines, each costing 1-2 Sparks to repair. Note that you must complete the Quest A Zipline Adventure before you can repair Zooplines.

Keroppi's adorable friend (and possible crush!) Keroleen now appears as an Island Visitor ! Keroleen is available as a Visitor after you have become Best Friends with Keroppi and completed the Quest Fond Pond . Decorate her Cabin and complete her Daily Quests to unlock her as a permanent resident - Keroppi will be thrilled!

In addition to the major changes listed above, the following have been added to Hello Kitty Island Adventure:

The 2026 Interlude of Dreams event is here! Play the Formula Fun mini-game daily to unlock racing themed clothing, cars, track pieces, and more!

A new Quest is available once you have unlocked all of Retsuko's coworkers as Permanent Residents. Stop President Elephant from turning Friendship Island into a golf course before it's too late!

You are now more likely to receive Hangyodon Furniture when following Currents.

The Usahana Yoga Mat item was made available to purchase in Badtz-Maru's Arcade.

The Stage furniture item can now be customized.

Several Quests received bug fixes to prevent characters from glitching out. In particular, Director Ton will no longer appear in multiple places at once during Quests where he features, and players should be able to correctly begin all Quests in the Time for Milk series.

articles.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Re-Release With New Footage Sets December Release Date, Tickets on Sale This Week
articles.summary: Marvel Studios has revealed the release date for its Spider-Man: Brand New Day re-release, promising to bring new footage "and a couple more surprises" to theaters this December.
articles.body:
Marvel Studios has revealed the release date for its Spider-Man: Brand New Day re-release, promising to bring new footage "and a couple more surprises" to theaters this December.

The official Spider-Man X/Twitter account confirmed plans to bring Peter Parker's (Tom Holland) first run-in with Jean Grey (Sadie Sink) back to moviegoers when the re-release arrives December 4, 2026. That means we're just a few weeks away from its premiere, with the full post teasing that this version of the movie is "an extended cut featuring new scenes and a couple more surprises."

Tickets go on sale this Thursday, November 19. Hope you're not busy!

As reported by Deadline earlier this year, Sony had plans to bring Spider-Man: Brand New Day back to theaters just months after the MCU movie's original premiere shattered records . Officially titled Spider-Man: Brand New Brand New Day, the outlet reported today that the plan is still for at least some of that new footage to include a cut scene featuring Rosario Dawson as her Defenders-era character, Night Nurse .

Even if you've had your fill of Holland's web-swinging antics for the year, Disney, Marvel, and Sony definitely know what they're doing when it comes to convincing MCU fans for a second round of their movies. Avengers: Doomsday will premiere just two weeks after Spidey returns. Although the December re-release may not be quite as likely to include any tie-in teaser footage like September's Avengers: Endgame Encore , Marvel fans will probably show up just to make sure, especially considering that "couple more surprises" tease.

There's also the fact that the wait for Avengers: Doomsday has already been quite long. Marvel has refrained from saying or showing too much about the film's actual plot, making that early December window a nice opportunity to capitalize on the hype and move Spider-Man's box-office needle just a little more.

Spider-Man: Brand New Day - Our Biggest Burning Questions

Spider-Man: Brand New Day premiered July 31, 2026, and was immediately a box office hit. It finally arrived on digital October 6 after grossing more than $2.5 billion worldwide, securing its place as one of the highest-grossing movies of all time.

IGN gave it a 7/10 review . At the time, we said it "effectively refocuses on the most reliable pillars of the webslinger: battling inner turmoil, swinging around NYC saving the day, and looking cool while doing so.
